html: <sherpa-node-stage slot="columns" data-heading="Intake" data-description="Where the rows come in" data-colour="#3b4ccd" data-x="40" data-w="360" data-removable data-first></sherpa-node-stage>
<sherpa-node-stage slot="columns" data-heading="Decide" data-x="416" data-w="320" data-removable data-last></sherpa-node-stage>
use: For the stages of a workflow on a `sherpa-layout-canvas`: one column each, in its `columns` slot, its bar along the top with its name and its band down the view. Its host writes where it stands and how wide (`data-x`, `data-w`, plane px), its colour, and `data-removable` while it is not the only one; `data-first` and `data-last` turn Move left and Move right off at the ends. More reports `stage-menu-select` (Edit, Add stage before, Add stage after, Remove), and Move left and Move right `stage-move`; its host adds, moves and names the stages. For nodes that belong together anywhere on the canvas, use `sherpa-node-frame`.
